newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland concerned about Belarus political troubles.
newsitem.headline: Poland concerned about Belarus political troubles.

text.p: Poland's Foreign Ministry on Sunday expressed concern over the political troubles in neighbouring Belarus and called for moderation, PAP news agency reported.

Demonstrators in Minsk, the capital of the former Soviet republic, clashed on Sunday with police amid mounting tensions over Belarussian President Alexander Lukashenko's bid to boost his power and stifle opposition.

"...Belarus is a signatory of international agreements obliging it to adhere to democratic norms...we therefore appeal for moderation, respect for human rights and civil liberties," PAP quoted a ministry statement as saying.
"...We appeal for a solution of the conflict in a constitutional manner which does not restrict media freedom nor basic civil liberties," the statement said.
It added that Poland fully respected the sovereignty of Belarus and did not intend to interfere in its internal affairs.
